definitions.explanation: The ninth sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly November 23 to December 21. Also the constellation Sagittarius. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{射手座|いてざ}です。
{射手座|いてざ}の{人|ひと}は{自由|じゆう}を{好|この}むと{言|い}われる。
examples.english: Sagittarius people are said to love freedom.

examples.japanese: {今週|こんしゅう}の{射手座|いてざ}は{旅行|りょこう}に{出|で}かけると{運|うん}が{開|ひら}けるそうだ。
examples.english: This week's horoscope says Sagittarius's luck will open up if they go on a trip.

notes:
The zodiac sign Sagittarius, for people born from late November to late December.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {射手座|いてざ}の{人|ひと}: a person born under Sagittarius
- {射手座|いてざ}{生|う}まれ: born a Sagittarius
- {射手座|いてざ}の{運勢|うんせい}: the Sagittarius horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are common small-talk in Japan and appear in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments ({星占|ほしうらな}い).
